briefs.claim_en: Drinking hot water mixed with lemon juice destroys the coronavirus.
briefs.brief_en: Multiple fact-checking organizations and medical institutions have debunked the claim that drinking hot water mixed with lemon juice destroys or cures the coronavirus. FactCheck.org, Snopes.com, and AFP Fact Check, in reports published between March and April 2020, state that there is no scientific evidence to support this. St. Vincent's Medical Center and the National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine also clarified in April and June 2020 that acidic drinks like lemon juice do not destroy viruses or prevent COVID-19, nor can they change the body's internal pH to achieve this effect. Hackensack Meridian Health also stated in March 2020 that home remedies, including lemon juice, are not proven to prevent or treat COVID-19.
